objective: Run official log-based and interactive end-to-end simulators to determine whether real reconstruction errors materially affect simulation; if first-return conflict is not impactful, investigate other feed-forward geometry/physics failures.
selection: First three lexicographically ordered public nuScenes scenes with an easy scenario in the official scenarios archive. Selected for integration before executing or inspecting policy outputs, not selected for geometric failure.
design: Establish official native simulator and frozen policy baseline
Trace geometry consumers: camera, LiDAR, static collision, dynamic collision, road height
Replay identical sensor poses and then paired closed-loop initial states
Intervene only on the measured reconstruction defect; preserve representation/readout and retain ordinary controls
Record both harmful and null results, with no requirement that first-return conflict be harmful
metrics: sensor change on actual policy inputs
boundary: A manual perturbation is sensitivity evidence, not a naturally occurring reconstruction badcase. LTF or HUGSIM alone is not all simulators. Camera expected depth is not physical LiDAR. Existing first-return scenes are exposed DEV. No previously sealed reserve is opened.
